title: BI/Data Warehouse Developer
description:
* Operate and continuously improve the CARS/BI backend within the global Enterprise Data


 Warehouse and Business Intelligence platform, ensuring system stability, continuous data
   

  

 loading, and the timely delivery of business\-critical reports.
   

  

* Own the underlying data foundation — SQL pipelines, relational data models, and data


 warehouse structures — that internal reporting teams and global Data Management initiatives
   

  

 depend on, and act as 1st and 2nd level support for internal customers such as SCM and
   

  

 Sales.
   

  

* The role is needed to secure daily BI availability in the Asian time zone, reduce the risk of late


 or incorrect reporting, and add dedicated database and ETL capacity to the global BI team,
   

  

 including support to the Data Center team on infrastructure\-related issues.
   

  

 Tasks and Responsibilities
   

  

 Describe the tasks and responsibilities in more detail. Use bullet points.
   

  

* Operate, monitor, and maintain the CARS/BI data integration and data processing workflows,


 ensuring continuous data loading and stable daily business operations.
   

  

* Provide 1st and 2nd level support for CARS/BI, including user support, incident handling, and


 root\-cause analysis of data issues.
   

  

* Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL\-based data pipelines and transformations within the


 Enterprise Data Warehouse.
   

  

* Design and maintain relational data models and data warehouse structures for CARS BI.
* Integrate data from ERP and other enterprise systems into the BI backend.
* Ensure data consistency, integrity, and performance at database level, including query tuning


 and database efficiency improvements.
   

  

* Administer the BI technical environment and contribute to its continuous enhancement as part


 of a global team.
   

  

* Support reporting teams by providing structured, reliable datasets and safeguarding the timely


 delivery of business\-critical reports.
   

  

* Contribute to global Data Management initiatives, with a focus on Master Data Management


 and the development of a Common Data Model within the Business Integration Platform.
   

  

* Collaborate with the Data Center team to resolve infrastructure\-related issues affecting BI


 availability.

title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cliniqon® is a specialized clinical outsourcing partner focused on transforming operations for Home Health and Hospice providers. The organization combines experienced clinical professionals with AI\-driven workflow automation to improve clinical outcomes, streamline processes, and strengthen compliance. Cliniqon® offers services including Home Health and Hospice Coding, Quality Assurance, Clinical Documentation Improvement, Revenue Cycle Management, and Clinical Administrative Support, all designed to boost revenue and reduce operational costs. With proprietary compliance tools such as CHAP\-verified audit solutions and a strong commitment to adapting to regulatory changes, Cliniqon® supports healthcare agencies in navigating evolving industry demands. The company is recognized as a Great Place To Work, reflecting its emphasis on employee well\-being and a positive workplace culture.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior .NET Developer with 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in backend development, Azure cloud services, and SQL Server.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise along with the ability to guide and mentor developers, take ownership of technical deliverables, review code, troubleshoot complex issues, and support the Team Lead in managing day\-to\-day technical activities.
 



 The candidate should be comfortable working across the complete development lifecycle, from technical design and development to deployment, production support, and performance optimization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and maintain applications and REST APIs using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core.
* Design, write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and database schemas.
* Design and implement scalable and maintainable technical solutions based on business requirements.
* Deploy, configure, and manage applications on Microsoft Azure, including App Services, Azure SQL, Storage, and related services.
* Take ownership of assigned modules and ensure timely delivery with expected quality.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, security practices, and development best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex staging and production issues and drive issues through to resolution.
* Identify performance, scalability, and reliability issues and recommend appropriate technical improvements.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid\-level developers.
* Support the Team Lead in technical planning, task allocation, estimation, and tracking of development activities.
* Participate in technical design and architecture discussions and contribute to architectural improvements.
* Review technical approaches and provide guidance to developers before implementation where required.
* Ensure proper understanding of the existing application, architecture, dependencies, and business flow before making significant changes.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release activities.
* Work closely with QA, BA, DevOps, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery.
* Proactively identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential production issues.
* Ensure proper documentation of technical solutions, application changes, and deployment\-related activities.
* Support the Team Lead in maintaining technical standards and improving overall team productivity and quality.



 Required Technical Skills
 


* Strong knowledge of C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, and object\-oriented programming principles.
* Strong hands\-on experience in building and consuming REST APIs.
* Solid experience with SQL Server, including complex queries, stored procedures, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Strong working experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, Azure DevOps, Application monitoring and deployment
* Strong experience with Git and version control workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Entity Framework / EF Core or similar ORMs.
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Experience with debugging, testing, and API testing tools such as xUnit, NUnit, Postman, or equivalent.
* Understanding of application performance optimization, scalability, and security best practices.
* Exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular is an added advantage.



 Technical Leadership \& Team Responsibilities
 


* Provide day\-to\-day technical guidance and support to developers.
* Mentor team members and help them improve their technical skills and development practices.
* Review implementation approaches and identify potential technical risks at an early stage.
* Conduct regular code reviews and ensure code quality across assigned modules.
* Assist the Team Lead in technical estimation, planning, and task prioritization.
* Take ownership of critical modules and production issues.
* Ensure developers follow established coding, Git, testing, and deployment practices.
* Help identify recurring technical issues and recommend long\-term solutions.
* Act as a technical point of contact for the team in the absence of the Team Lead.
* Support knowledge sharing and maintain proper technical documentation within the team.



 Candidate Profile
 


* 8\+ years of strong hands\-on experience in .NET development.
* Previous experience in a Senior Developer, Module Lead, or similar technical leadership role is preferred.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong understanding of existing applications and ability to quickly analyze complex codebases.
* Demonstrated ability to take end\-to\-end ownership of technical deliverables.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to mentor and guide team members effectively.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong focus on code quality, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Experience handling production\-critical issues and customer\-facing technical challenges.
* Ability to make sound technical decisions and recommend practical solutions.
* Willingness to learn and adopt new technologies, tools, and cloud services.

title: WordPress Developer
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Design, customize, and maintain WordPress websites that deliver seamless functionality, engaging user experiences, and strong performance across digital platforms. The WordPress Developer role focuses on building and maintaining client websites using WordPress. Responsibilities include developing custom themes and plugins, integrating APIs, and optimizing sites for speed, SEO, and security. This position requires strong technical expertise in PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with the ability to collaborate with designers, content teams, and clients. It offers opportunities to work on diverse projects, ensuring responsive design, accessibility, and long‑term scalability.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop custom WordPress themes and plugins using PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Customize websites with tools such as Gutenberg, Elementor, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
* Integrate APIs including payment gateways and social media platforms
* Optimize websites for performance, SEO, and security using caching and security plugins
* Troubleshoot and debug WordPress issues to ensure smooth functionality
* Collaborate with designers, content teams, and clients for project success
* Ensure responsive design, accessibility, and cross‑browser compatibility
* Document code, workflows, and processes for future reference


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (BCA, MCA, BSc Computer Science, B‑Tech in CS)
* Minimum of 1 years of professional experience in WordPress development
* Proficiency in PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (jQuery, React optional)
* Experience with custom/child themes, plugins, and WP‑CLI
* Familiarity with SEO, caching tools (W3 Total Cache, WP Rocket), and security plugins (Wordfence)
* Strong knowledge of responsive and accessible design principles
* Experience with Git/GitHub for version control
* Problem‑solving, communication, and client management skills
